diagnosis.summary: The parser does not normalize blank input.
diagnosis.root_cause: parse_value returns the input directly before checking for blank content.

proposed_change.summary: Return None for an empty or whitespace-only value.
proposed_change.patch:
diff --git a/src/parser.py b/src/parser.py
--- a/src/parser.py
+++ b/src/parser.py
@@ -1,2 +1,4 @@
 def parse_value(value):
+    if not value or not value.strip():
+        return None
     return value

risks: Callers that relied on an empty string will now receive None.
assumptions: Input values are strings or None.
